name: whe i'm in a competition and my opponent is
meaning: A text template above a close-up of a terrified Squidward. For facing an opponent so strong or skilled that you have already lost.

baked_in_text: The image already reads "when I'm in a" / "competition and my" / "opponent is". Captions fill in the blanks only.
